mapper.select: select distinct CDATE cdate from BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE where ifnull(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} order by cdate

select FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS PRODID, FP1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS FPROD_ID, BPP.FEE_TYPE AS FEE_TYPE, BPP.CDATE AS CDATE, ifnull(FCP.PAY_DATE,FP.MDATE) AS PAYDATE, BPP.TDY_POSITION, BPP.TDY_INTINCEXP_ADD, BPP.TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP, FCI.CCY, ifnull(BPP.UPDATE_TIME,BPP.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME, ifnull(BPP.CREATE_TIME,BPP.UPDATE_TIME) CREATE_TIME
from BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE BPP LEFT JOIN fin_product FP ON BPP.FINPROD_ID=FP.FINPROD_ID and FP.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL LEFT JOIN fin_product FP1 ON BPP.FINPROD_ID=FP1.FINPROD_ID and BPP.P_FINPROD_ID is not null LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON FCI.FINPROD_ID=BPP.FINPROD_ID AND BPP.FEE_TYPE=FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MIN(PAY_DATE) PAY_DATE,CASH_ID FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE DATE_FORMAT(PAY_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d')>=#{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY CASH_ID) FCP ON FCP.CASH_ID=FCI.CASH_ID WHERE DATE_FORMAT(BPP.CDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')=#{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and BPP.FEE_TYPE in ('C03','C04','C05','C06','C09','C10','C18')
